newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares tad down, ATX seen around 1,200.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares tad down, ATX seen around 1,200.

text.p: Shares in Vienna slipped a shade on Tuesday after aimless trading in a narrow range.
Traders said they expect upcoming earnings results for last year to breathe life into the market.
The ATX index ended 1.73 points, or 0.14 percent, lower at 1,200.23 points after moving within 1,198.71 to 1,203.94 points.
"The market should basically continue to trade with a positive bias," said one trader, adding that the market had until now reacted well to earnings results from companies.
Mayr-Melnhof reports 1996 results on Wednesday and Verbund on February 17.
Of the blue-chip index's 21 constituents, 12 stocks advanced, while nine fell.
The day's worst performer was microchip maker AMS, falling 3.2 percent to 1,090 schillings after Monday's strong gains.
The leading gainer was Creditanstalt's preferred shares, climbing 2.66 percent to 416.2 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index lost 0.15 points, or 0.03 percent, to close at 446.96 points.
The ATX February future added on 1.4 points to 1,203.0 on turnover of 518 contracts.
